question.en: Discuss the role of UNIDO in achieving the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), particularly SDG 9.
question.hi: Discuss the role of UNIDO in achieving the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), particularly SDG 9.

modelAnswer.en: UNIDO plays a critical role in SDG 9 (Industry, Innovation, and Infrastructure) by providing technical assistance to developing nations to build resilient infrastructure, promote inclusive industrialization, and foster innovation. It helps countries transition to green industries, improve resource efficiency, and integrate into global value chains.
